collection_note: Partial collection. The agenticworkflows logs path hit the MCP gateway 60-second context deadline after six bounded pages (six log batches; observed run data reaches only 2026-11-26T21:15:01Z). Workflow run counts were recovered from paginated GitHub Actions API data for the full 24-hour window. GitHub API safe-output and engagement attribution was blocked: issue search returned 17 matching items that were filtered by the integrity policy, PR search returned no usable payload, and reading discussion content was filtered by the integrity policy. Safe-output activity and engagement counts are null; no zero values were inferred. Delivery/adoption below contains only partial observations from available log pages. API fallback does not provide complete-window token or cost data, so those values are null.
